node.statement: For e<=e_act, positivity of e_col,e_var,e_as and the factor 1/2 give e<=e_col/2<e_col, e<=e_var/2<e_var, and e<=e_as/2<e_as. Thus the column-Hilbert estimate itself is available at e<e_col, and the strict e_var,e_as hypotheses of validated node 1.3 hold, including at e=e_act.
